name: @equin/plugin-infra-host-idle
description: The host idle signal: whether nothing on the machine is working — no agent, no op, no duress — sustained for 10 minutes. Contributed blockers (IdleBlocker) say what is busy; main's host-idle.evaluate job folds them (nextIdleState) into host_idle_state, emits host.idleBegan / host.idleEnded on transitions, and serves the hostIdle value.
